finding.claim: After a kmctl upgrade without update, status lists two problems with different fixes: 'installed plugin 0.2.0 ... run kmctl plugin update' and 'staged plugin 0.2.0 ... run kmctl plugin install'. Following the second runs install, which now refuses with 'run kmctl plugin update'. The staged-copy hint should name update when the installed version is also behind (or be left out then).

fixes.change: A staged-copy mismatch now says run kmctl plugin update, the same fix as an installed mismatch, so status never points at an install that would refuse.
